subject: RM_SuspensionAnchor_Timber
label: Drawbridge anchor ropes (Timber, Scrapper look)
provenance: offline render 2026-10-23 · DRAWBRIDGE_CABLES_FIX_STOP_SHORT (render_cables.py mirror of the print path)
description: The two bollards at each end of a one-lane drawbridge over a pit, each holding a rope/cable to the bridge deck. LOWERED: the ropes must run continuously from each bollard's clamp to the deck's end, with no gap, on both banks, in every rotation. RAISED (the deck stands upright at the hinge bank as a tall leaf drawn upward): the owner's rule is 'Ropes should now be slack and disconnected' - no rope crosses or points over the pit, each bollard's rope lies as a loose slack loop on the bank, and no stiff rope sticks up from the top of the raised leaf. Images are OFFLINE renders reproducing the game's print path (deck squares are the plain deck tile for context; the pit is a flat dark rectangle).
ports: each bollard: one rope toward the deck it faces
